name: std::numeric_limits<T>::is_bounded
intro: The value of std::numeric_limits<T>::is_bounded is true for all arithmetic types T that represent a finite set of values. While all fundamental types are bounded, this constant would be false in a specialization of std::numeric_limits for a library-provided arbitrary precision arithmetic type.
